Una foto può dire dove vivi, a che ora e: A photo can say where you live, when you go out and where you go to school. Even if you don’t write it.
<span class=\"pp-anim__n\" aria-hidden=\: 1 A photo says more than it seems: the background, the place, the time.
2 Put together, the details say where to find you.
3 Location off and friends only: you decide who sees you.
Elena pubblica una storia: la divisa del: Elena posts a story: her team kit, the school gate in the background and her location switched on, “so people can see where it is”.
Il suo profilo ha 600 follower. Ne conos: Her profile has 600 followers. She actually knows about fifty of them.
Cosa ha raccontato Elena, senza volerlo?: What did Elena give away without meaning to?
Apri le risposte e scopri come va a fini: Open the answers and find out how it ends.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: A Only that she plays volleyball.
Anche dove si allena, dove va a scuola e: Also where she trains, where she goes to school and when: you just have to put the details together.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: B Where she goes to school, where she trains and when: any of her followers can piece it together.
Esatto. Ogni dettaglio da solo è innocuo: Exactly. Each detail on its own is harmless; together they make a map of her day.
<span class=\"pp-choice__letter\" aria-h: C Nothing: her profile is private.
Un profilo privato con 600 follower non: A private profile with 600 followers isn’t that private: and a story can be saved and passed around.
Scegli il livello: la verità è la stessa: Pick your level: the truth is the same, only the words change.
Prima di mettere una foto online, chiedi: Before putting a photo online, ask a grown-up. Never put your address, school or full name online.
Le foto degli amici si pubblicano solo s: Photos of friends only go online if they say yes.
Ogni foto contiene dettagli: luoghi, nom: Every photo contains details: places, names, uniforms, times, sometimes your exact location.
Una volta online, un contenuto può esser: Once online, content can be saved and shared by anyone who sees it.
Decidi tu chi ti vede: le impostazioni d: You decide who sees you: privacy settings are your gate.
OSINT: dettagli dello sfondo, divise, in: OSINT: background details, uniforms, signs and reflections can be used to locate a photo. EXIF metadata can contain GPS coordinates and the device model: many platforms strip it, but that isn’t guaranteed for every channel.
Il rischio vero è l’aggregazione: dati i: The real risk is aggregation: harmless details become a profile once they’re put together. On EVIL you can measure your exposure in the OSINT area.
Prendi il telefono: lo facciamo insieme,: Grab your phone: let’s do it together, right now.
Nelle impostazioni del social controlla: In your social media settings, check who can see your posts and who can message you.
Disattiva la posizione nelle foto e nell: Turn off location on photos and stories.
Guarda le tue ultime 5 foto pubblicate:: Look at your last 5 posted photos: can you see your school, street, number plate or house number? Remove or hide them.
Prima di pubblicare la foto di un amico,: Before posting a photo of a friend, ask them.
<strong>Sì, va bene.</strong> Un bel pan: Yes, that’s fine. A nice view, with no personal details.
Una foto della carta d’identità: A photo of your ID card
<strong>Meglio di no.</strong> Con i dat: Better not. With the details from an ID, someone can pretend to be you.
Una storia con la posizione in tempo rea: A story with your live location
<strong>Meglio di no.</strong> Dice a tu: Better not. It tells everyone where you are right now.
Un disegno o un video che hai fatto tu: A drawing or a video you made
<strong>Sì, va bene.</strong> Le tue cre: Yes, that’s fine. Your creations are yours: show them without personal details.
La foto di un amico, senza chiedergli il: A photo of a friend, without asking them
<strong>Meglio di no.</strong> Prima chi: Better not. Ask first: their image belongs to them.
Il cancello della scuola con il nome ben: The school gate with its name clearly visible
<strong>Meglio di no.</strong> Dice dove: Better not. It says where to find you every morning.
